description: This file defines the WordComposer class, which manages the state of a word being typed or composed in an input method, including keystrokes, surrounding key codes, and related metadata.

classes.name: WordComposer
classes.description: A class that manages the current state of a word being typed, including keystrokes, surrounding key codes, capitalization, and related metadata.

methods.name: cloneInto
methods.description: Copies the current WordComposer's state into another WordComposer instance.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears the current state, preparing for a new word.

methods.name: codePointCount
methods.description: Returns the number of keystrokes (codepoints) in the current word.

methods.name: charCount
methods.description: Returns the number of characters in the typed word.

methods.name: cursorPosition
methods.description: Returns the current cursor position within the word.

methods.name: setCursorPosition
methods.description: Sets the cursor position within the word.

methods.name: getCodesAt
methods.description: Retrieves the array of key codes at a specific position.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new keystroke with associated codes at the current cursor position.

methods.name: simulateTypedWord
methods.description: Simulates typing a sequence of characters into the WordComposer.

methods.name: getReusableArray
methods.description: Provides a reusable array for storing key codes, optimizing memory usage.

methods.name: correctPrimaryJuxtapos
methods.description: Adjusts the primary key code and its neighboring codes based on touch proximity.

methods.name: deleteTextAtCurrentPositionTillEnd
methods.description: Deletes text from the current position to the end of the typed word.

methods.name: deleteCodePointAtCurrentPosition
methods.description: Deletes the last codepoint at the current cursor position.

methods.name: deleteForward
methods.description: Deletes the character immediately after the cursor.

methods.name: getTypedWord
methods.description: Returns the word as typed so far, without corrections.

methods.name: isAtTagsSearchState
methods.description: Checks if the current word is in a special tags search state (starts with ':').

methods.name: setFirstCharCapitalized
methods.description: Sets whether the first character is capitalized.

methods.name: isFirstCharCapitalized
methods.description: Checks if the first character was capitalized.

methods.name: isAllUpperCase
methods.description: Checks if all typed characters are uppercase.

methods.name: setPreferredWord
methods.description: Stores a preferred word choice before committing.

methods.name: getPreferredWord
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred word if set, otherwise the typed word.

methods.name: isMostlyCaps
methods.description: Checks if most characters are uppercase.

methods.name: setAutoCapitalized
methods.description: Records whether the word was automatically capitalized.

methods.name: isAutoCapitalized
methods.description: Checks if the word was automatically capitalized.

methods.name: logCodes
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the word's codes for debugging.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the WordComposer currently has no keystrokes.
